purpose: Teach: 希薄/発端/制覇/切実/偏差/弁論/捕獲/子宮

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療資源が希薄な地域を医療チームで支援しております
lines.en: Ren, we run a medical support team for regions where resources are scarce.
lines.style: Direct, measured explanation. Clear-eyed and factual. Not rushed. A professional explaining something important to an attentive student.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 感染症の発端を、貴院、追跡されたんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital actually traced back the source of the infection, didn't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuinely curious, slightly hesitant. Asking respectfully, not challenging. Leaning in just slightly with genuine interest.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、特定病の制覇を目指して医療チームは研究しております
lines.en: Yes. Our team researches with the aim of conquering specific diseases.
lines.style: Steady, explaining without condescension. A slight pause after the affirmation. Clinical but not cold—this work matters to her.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 切実な医療相談を、貴院、断らないんですね、先生
lines.en: I see—so your hospital doesn't turn away urgent medical consultations, then.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause at the opening. Speaking more to himself than asking. Registering respect for what he's learning.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、検査値の偏差を医療チームでも丁寧に評価します
lines.en: That's correct. Our team evaluates test result variations with real care and precision.
lines.style: Factual continuation, but warmer now. She's answering what he's really asking—whether patients matter here, not just data.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、医療弁論大会にも参加されておられますね、先生
lines.en: And your hospital participates in medical debate competitions too, I understand.
lines.style: Quiet realization dawning mid-sentence. Not a question but an observation. Appreciating something larger taking shape.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、外来動物の捕獲時の応急処置も医療チームで行います
lines.en: Yes. Our team also provides emergency treatment during invasive wildlife captures.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact response. A slight shift—slightly amused at the scope. Something both practical and unusual.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、子宮検診をいち早く導入されたとのこと、先生
lines.en: Your hospital was among the first to introduce cervical screening, weren't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Final observation, almost reverent. Voice softening with genuine admiration. Not asking for confirmation—understanding fully.
